dialogs.text: Between the rocks and the boulders... Leaping back and forth, moving ever faster...
So, the challenge... You up for it?
Let's do this!
Give me a moment to prep...
Hehe. I felt your presence from afar, outlander warrior. Very impressive!
Wanna take part in this Warrior's Challenge? Not to brag or anything, but I'm sure my trial will be of great help to you.
Let's begin!
Give me a moment to prep...
Hmm... Outlander warrior, I have a favor to ask.
I am the "Master Trainer" of our tribe, but my abilities have yet to match my title, so I can't be sure about the difficulty of the "Warrior's Challenge" I've come up with...
So, could you help me test it?
Sure.
Give me a moment to prep...
For us, the Scions of the Canopy, agility and finesse are essential qualities, and that's why I've prepared this Warrior's Challenge.
So, outlander warrior! Wanna take a swing at this?
Let's begin!
Give me a moment to prep...
Hmm, a rare guest from afar, I see. Well, what do you say? Wanna try my Warrior's Challenge?
Many a Warrior's Challenge awaits our tribal fighters throughout Natlan. And as for me, I'm one of those who arranges those challenges.
Well, don't you look like a tough one, outlander? Wanna take on the challenge that I've prepared?
Let's begin!
Give me a moment to prep...
This Warrior's Challenge is designed for couriers, so it will be tough. Not that I'm underestimating you, of course.
How about it? Want to give it a go?
Let's begin!
Give me a moment to prep...
There's nothing more fun than leaping up high, before feeling the weightlessness of your fall.
Hey there! What would you say to trying out my Warrior's Challenge?
Let's begin!
Give me a moment to prep...
Wanna try out this Spiritway challenge?
Well, you're here, so you might as well give it a whirl! Sure beats going back empty-handed, am I right?
Let's begin!
Give me a moment to prep...
I love the feeling of sliding along the Spiritways. There's nothing more soothing than hearing the wind whistling in your ears.
I became a Master Trainer to help our tribespeople understand the joys of gliding along Spiritways even as I train them to become warriors.
What about you? Wanna try joining in?
Let's begin!
Give me a moment to prep...
To follow the veins of the earth is most important indeed...
Collect as many Challenge Coins as you can and complete the challenge. I've naught but faith in you!
Um... Collect the Challenge Coins along your path and... better yet, try to catch up to the little Tepetlisaurus.
Why? Well, little Tepetlisaurs are really cute, so I thought this would make things more interesting...
Stay quick on your feet and grab all the Challenge Coins you can... Yeah, that's kinda how the trial's gonna go.
Well, simply put, just collect Challenge Coins, as many as you can get. The more, the better! The quicker, the stronger!
Use the grappling hook... or other means, to collect the explosive barrels and defeat your foes. This, too, is one of a messenger's many tasks... sorta.
You can use Jet-Set Eddies to reach high places, and it's quite the experience to boot. Be careful when you land in the water, though.
Get on the Spiritway, then... Uh, how do I put it? Earn a higher score with some flashy-splashy motions? Something like that! There you go, super easy.
Riding Spiritways is unbelievably fun, and I'd love to share that with more folks.
